rationale:
Retain 14 prior roles and replace cache_conflict_layout with register_reuse. The tested 272-byte and 288-byte padding variants established no repeatable gain; cache-set geometry remains unknown. Register reuse provides another review angle for distinct changes within four ZA.S tiles.

Assembly and compiler advisors can use the supplied source and actual compiler output. Descriptor, transpose, packing, traversal, and streaming advisors cover complete conversion-and-consumption paths. Scratch and tail advisors cover timed allocation, failure safety, bounds, and general sizes.

Corrected inventory: TA and TT full-call wrappers remain unmeasured. TA requires [4]=transpose(B), [10]=original A; TT requires both physical transposes. SME-transpose TB failed promotion on AC and its battery replay; NEON-transpose TB also failed on battery. These results do not isolate component costs or establish NEON versus SME transpose performance. Four-step unrolling is also measured and rejected.

This roster selects no experiment. Advisors must propose distinct legal changes, reject tested aliases, and jointly rank the batch. Advice remains unverified. Preserve all fixed constraints, budgets, power settings, ten candidate reports and ten alternating paired controls, best-of-three timing, min(candidate)>1.05*max(controls), and the held-out check. Report historical and fresh same-mode comparisons without choosing comparator policy.
